item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.


Green Jelly backing band performing 2 sets with Green Jelly standards and songs off his parody songs album. The show was marred by a fan falling off his stool, hitting his head and being taken away in an ambulance leaving a bloody puddle behind. Was mainly there as I have been meaning to see Spice Pistols forever but my friend is a big Green Jelly fan and gave me a ride home otherwise 2 hours (including intermission) was probably more than can handle at risk of ending tragically for me too. Awesome venue however and I hope to go back.

I also saw the original Spice Pistols when Steve Jones joined Melanie C for Anarchy In The UK in 1999.
